data.narrative:
Onodrim Industries is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised €40M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers across Defense & Security: 8 private companies including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, alongside 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis uses the €40M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier, implying a valuation of $100M. Peer-Median analysis examines four same-sector peers at Seed or Series A stage—UFORCE ($1.0B), Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—yielding a median valuation of $700M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B. The Stage-Progression method substantially underweights the company relative to recent peer outcomes; the Peer-Median approach captures wider market heterogeneity in the sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $85M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $400M. This wide band reflects material uncertainty around how investors will price frontier-tech defensibility, customer concentration risk, and the degree to which recent mega-rounds at peers like UFORCE and Stark Defence represent sustainable market pricing or outlier events. The high end is anchored to peer-median; the low end assumes more conservative stage-based progression logic.
